units.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights
units.text: 4.1. Unjustified refusal to consider a consumer’s claims relating to a violation of their rights, or evasion of the consideration of such claims in the procedure established by law, —
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 14.8

units.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 14.8 · “shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifteen…”

units.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights
units.text: 5. Refusal to supply a consumer with goods (perform work or provide services) or to give them access to goods (work or services) for reasons relating to their health, limitations on their daily functioning or their age, except in cases established by law, —
units.label: Part 5 Art. 14.8

units.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 14.8 · “shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty…”

units.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights
units.text: 6. Sale of certain types of technically complex goods with preinstalled computer programs in violation of the requirement established by consumer protection legislation to ensure the ability to use those types of technically complex goods with preinstalled computer programs originating in the Russian Federation or other member states of the Eurasian Economic Union —
units.label: Part 6 Art. 14.8

units.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 14.8 · “shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty…”

units.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights
units.text: 7. Refusal to conclude, perform, amend or terminate an agreement with a consumer because the consumer refuses to provide personal data, except where providing personal data is mandatory under federal laws and other normative legal acts adopted in accordance with them or is directly related to performance of the agreement with the consumer, and except in the cases provided for by Part 8 of this Article, —
units.label: Part 7 Art. 14.8

units.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; for legal entities, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 14.8 · “shall entail an administrative fine for officials of five…”

units.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights
units.text: 8. Refusal to conclude, perform, amend or terminate an agreement with a consumer because the consumer refuses to undergo identification and/or authentication using their biometric personal data —
units.label: Part 8 Art. 14.8

units.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 14.8 · “shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifty…”

units.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights
units.text: Note. Where two or more consumers are simultaneously refused the supply of goods (performance of work or provision of services) or access to goods (work or services) for reasons relating to their health, limitations on their daily functioning or age, or where one consumer, or two or more consumers simultaneously, are repeatedly refused on those grounds, the administrative liability provided for by Part 5 of this Article shall arise for the refusal to each consumer and for each instance of refusal separately.
units.label: Art. 14.8 · “Note. Where two or more consumers are simultaneously refused…”

units.locator: Article 14.9. Restriction of competition by public authorities or local self-government bodies
units.text: Article 14.9. Restriction of competition by public authorities or local self-government bodies
units.label: Art. 14.9

units.locator: Article 14.9. Restriction of competition by public authorities or local self-government bodies
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.9. Restriction of competition by public authorities or local self-government bodies
units.label: Art. 14.9

units.locator: Article 14.9. Restriction of competition by public authorities or local self-government bodies
units.text: 1. Acts (omissions) by officials of federal executive bodies, executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, local self-government bodies, other bodies or organisations performing their functions, state extra-budgetary funds, or organisations participating in the provision of state or municipal services, which are prohibited under the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation and result or may result in the prevention, restriction or elimination of competition, or restriction of the free movement of goods (work or services) or freedom of economic activity, except in the cases provided for by Part 7 of Article 14.32 of this Code, —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14.9

units.locator: Article 14.9. Restriction of competition by public authorities or local self-government bodies
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifteen thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14.9 · “shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifteen…”

units.locator: Article 14.9. Restriction of competition by public authorities or local self-government bodies
units.text: 2. Acts by the officials specified in Part 1 of this Article which are prohibited under the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation and result or may result in the prevention, restriction or elimination of competition, or restriction of the free movement of goods (work or services) or freedom of economic activity, where those officials have previously been subjected to an administrative penalty for a similar administrative offence, —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14.9

units.locator: Article 14.9. Restriction of competition by public authorities or local self-government bodies
units.text: shall entail disqualification for up to three years.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14.9 · “shall entail disqualification for up to three years.”

units.locator: Article 14.9.1. Violation of the procedure for measures and/or procedures in implementing a capital construction project
units.text: Article 14.9.1. Violation of the procedure for measures and/or procedures in implementing a capital construction project
units.label: Art. 14.9.1

units.locator: Article 14.9.1. Violation of the procedure for measures and/or procedures in implementing a capital construction project
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.9.1. Violation of the procedure for measures and/or procedures in implementing a capital construction project
units.label: Art. 14.9.1

units.locator: Article 14.9.1. Violation of the procedure for measures and/or procedures in implementing a capital construction project
units.text: 1. Acts (omissions) by officials of federal executive bodies, public authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, local self-government bodies, other bodies or organisations performing the functions of those bodies, or organisations participating in the provision of state or municipal services, when carrying out, in relation to legal entities and individual entrepreneurs who are participants in urban planning relations, measures and/or procedures provided for by urban planning legislation in implementing a capital construction project (hereinafter, measures in implementing a construction project), which are subject to appeal under the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation and consist in: breach of established deadlines for measures in implementing a construction project; requiring measures and/or procedures not provided for by urban planning legislation or requiring documents, information, materials or approvals not included in the register of documents, information, materials and approvals necessary for implementing a construction project provided for by the urban planning legislation of the Russian Federation; unlawful refusal to accept documents or applications; or imposing on the complainant, documents or information requirements not established by federal laws, other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation or normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation when carrying out measures in implementing a construction project, except in the cases provided for by Article 5.63 of this Code, —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14.9.1

units.locator: Article 14.9.1. Violation of the procedure for measures and/or procedures in implementing a capital construction project
units.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of three thousand to five thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14.9.1 · “shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials…”

units.locator: Article 14.9.1. Violation of the procedure for measures and/or procedures in implementing a capital construction project
units.text: 2. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by Part 1 of this Article —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14.9.1

units.locator: Article 14.9.1. Violation of the procedure for measures and/or procedures in implementing a capital construction project
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to two years.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14.9.1 · “shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty…”

units.locator: Article 14.10. Unlawful use of means of individualising goods (work or services)
units.text: Article 14.10. Unlawful use of means of individualising goods (work or services)
units.label: Art. 14.10

units.locator: Article 14.10. Unlawful use of means of individualising goods (work or services)
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.10. Unlawful use of means of individualising goods (work or services)
units.label: Art. 14.10

units.locator: Article 14.10. Unlawful use of means of individualising goods (work or services)
units.text: 1. Unlawful use of another person’s trademark, service mark or appellation of origin, or designations similar to them for goods of the same kind, except in the cases provided for by Part 2 of this Article, —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14.10

units.locator: Article 14.10. Unlawful use of means of individualising goods (work or services)
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to ten thousand roubles, with confiscation of items bearing an unlawful reproduction of the trademark, service mark or appellation of origin, as well as materials and equipment used to manufacture them and other instruments used to commit the administrative offence; for officials, ten thousand to fifty thousand roubles, with confiscation of items bearing an unlawful reproduction of the trademark, service mark or appellation of origin, as well as materials and equipment used to manufacture them and other instruments used to commit the administrative offence; for legal entities, fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles, with confiscation of items bearing an unlawful reproduction of the trademark, service mark or appellation of origin, as well as materials and equipment used to manufacture them and other instruments used to commit the administrative offence.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14.10 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five…”

units.locator: Article 14.10. Unlawful use of means of individualising goods (work or services)
units.text: 2. Producing for sale or selling goods bearing an unlawful reproduction of another person’s trademark, service mark or appellation of origin, or designations similar to them for goods of the same kind, except in the cases provided for by Part 2 of Article 14.33 of this Code, where those acts do not constitute a criminal offence, —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14.10

units.locator: Article 14.10. Unlawful use of means of individualising goods (work or services)
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of twice the value of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, but not less than ten thousand roubles, with confiscation of items bearing an unlawful reproduction of the trademark, service mark or appellation of origin, as well as materials and equipment used to manufacture them and other instruments used to commit the administrative offence; for officials, three times the value of those goods, but not less than fifty thousand roubles, with confiscation of items bearing an unlawful reproduction of the trademark, service mark or appellation of origin, as well as materials and equipment used to manufacture them and other instruments used to commit the administrative offence; for legal entities, five times the value of those goods, but not less than one hundred thousand roubles, with confiscation of items bearing an unlawful reproduction of the trademark, service mark or appellation of origin, as well as materials and equipment used to manufacture them and other instruments used to commit the administrative offence.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14.10 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of twice the…”

units.locator: Article 14.11. Unlawful obtaining of a credit or loan
units.text: Article 14.11. Unlawful obtaining of a credit or loan
units.label: Art. 14.11

units.locator: Article 14.11. Unlawful obtaining of a credit or loan
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.11. Unlawful obtaining of a credit or loan
units.label: Art. 14.11

units.locator: Article 14.11. Unlawful obtaining of a credit or loan
units.text: Obtaining a credit or loan or preferential lending terms by providing a bank or other creditor with knowingly false information about one’s business circumstances or financial position —
units.label: Art. 14.11 · “Obtaining a credit or loan or preferential lending terms by…”

units.locator: Article 14.11. Unlawful obtaining of a credit or loan
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to two thousand roubles; for officials, two thousand to three thousand roubles; for legal entities, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
units.label: Art. 14.11 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one…”

units.locator: Article 14.12. Fictitious or deliberate bankruptcy
units.text: Article 14.12. Fictitious or deliberate bankruptcy
units.label: Art. 14.12

units.locator: Article 14.12. Fictitious or deliberate bankruptcy
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.12. Fictitious or deliberate bankruptcy
units.label: Art. 14.12

units.locator: Article 14.12. Fictitious or deliberate bankruptcy
units.text: 1. Fictitious bankruptcy, that is, a knowingly false public declaration by the head or founder (member) of a legal entity that the legal entity is insolvent, or by an individual entrepreneur or citizen that they are insolvent, where that act does not constitute a criminal offence, —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14.12

units.locator: Article 14.12. Fictitious or deliberate bankruptcy
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to three thousand roubles; for officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles, or disqualification for six months to three years.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14.12 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one…”

units.locator: Article 14.12. Fictitious or deliberate bankruptcy
units.text: 2. Deliberate bankruptcy, that is, acts (omissions) by the head or founder (member) of a legal entity, or by an individual entrepreneur or citizen, which knowingly cause the legal entity, individual entrepreneur or citizen to become unable to satisfy in full creditors’ claims relating to monetary obligations and/or fulfil the obligation to make mandatory payments, where those acts (omissions) do not constitute criminal offences, —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14.12

units.locator: Article 14.12. Fictitious or deliberate bankruptcy
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to three thousand roubles; for officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles, or disqualification for one to three years.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14.12 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one…”

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.label: Art. 14.13

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.label: Art. 14.13

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: 1. Concealing property, property rights or property obligations, information about property, its amount or location, or other information about property, property rights or property obligations; transferring property into the possession of other persons, disposing of or destroying property; or concealing, destroying or falsifying accounting and other records reflecting the economic activity of a legal entity or individual entrepreneur, where those acts are committed when there are signs of bankruptcy of the legal entity or signs of inability to pay of the individual entrepreneur or citizen and do not constitute criminal offences, —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14.13

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of four thousand to five thousand roubles; for officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles, or disqualification for six months to three years.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14.13 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of four…”

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: 2. Unlawfully satisfying the property claims of individual creditors from the property of a debtor legal entity by the head or founder (member) of that legal entity, or by an individual entrepreneur or citizen, knowingly to the detriment of other creditors; or acceptance of such satisfaction by creditors aware that they have been given preference to the detriment of other creditors, where those acts are committed when there are signs of bankruptcy and do not constitute criminal offences, —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14.13

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of four thousand to five thousand roubles; for officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles, or disqualification for six months to three years.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14.13 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of four…”

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: 3. Failure by an insolvency practitioner, registrar, auction organiser, electronic platform operator or head of the temporary administration of a credit or other financial organisation to fulfil obligations established by insolvency (bankruptcy) legislation, where that act (omission) does not constitute a criminal offence, —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 14.13

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of twenty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to two hundred and fifty thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 14.13 · “shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials…”

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: 3.1. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 3 of this Article, where that act does not constitute a criminal offence, —
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 14.13

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: shall entail disqualification of officials for six months to three years; an administrative fine for legal entities of three hundred and fifty thousand to one million roubles.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 14.13 · “shall entail disqualification of officials for six months to…”

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: 4. Unlawfully obstructing the activities of an insolvency practitioner, a bankruptcy liquidation administrator or the temporary administration of a credit or other financial organisation, including delayed provision, evasion or refusal to hand over to them information and/or documents necessary to fulfil their duties and/or property belonging to a legal entity, including a credit or other financial organisation, where the functions of the head of that legal entity, including the credit or other financial organisation, have been assigned respectively to the insolvency practitioner, bankruptcy liquidation administrator or head of the temporary administration of the credit or other financial organisation, where those acts (omissions) do not constitute criminal offences, —
units.label: Part 4 Art. 14.13

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for six months to one year.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 14.13 · “shall entail an administrative fine for officials of forty…”

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: 4.1. Acts (omissions) provided for by Part 4 of this Article, or concealment of documents and other information media, directed against representatives of the Bank of Russia or the state corporation “Deposit Insurance Agency” in connection with their exercise of powers when analysing a bank’s financial position in accordance with Federal Law of 26 October 2002 No. 127-FZ “On Insolvency (Bankruptcy)” —
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 14.13

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for six months to one year.
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 14.13 · “shall entail an administrative fine for officials of forty…”

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: 5. Failure by the head of a legal entity, an individual entrepreneur or a citizen to fulfil the obligation to apply to an arbitrazh court for a declaration of bankruptcy of the legal entity, individual entrepreneur or citizen respectively in the cases provided for by insolvency (bankruptcy) legislation —
units.label: Part 5 Art. 14.13

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to three thousand roubles; for officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 14.13 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one…”

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: 5.1. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 5 of this Article —
units.label: Part 5.1 Art. 14.13

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; for officials, disqualification for six months to three years.
units.label: Part 5.1 Art. 14.13 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of three…”

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: 6. Failure by the head of a legal entity, within the period established by insolvency (bankruptcy) legislation, to send the owner of the property of a debtor unitary enterprise and persons entitled to initiate the convening of an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders (members) information on the existence of signs of bankruptcy, as well as a copy of the debtor’s application when filed with an arbitrazh court and of the debtor’s response to an application for a declaration of the debtor’s bankruptcy, —
units.label: Part 6 Art. 14.13

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for six months to two years.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 14.13 · “shall entail an administrative fine for officials of…”

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: 7. Unlawful obstruction by an individual entrepreneur or citizen of the activities of an insolvency practitioner approved by an arbitrazh court in the bankruptcy case of that individual entrepreneur or citizen, including evasion or refusal to provide information in cases provided for by insolvency (bankruptcy) legislation or to hand over documents necessary for the insolvency practitioner to fulfil their duties, where those acts (omissions) do not constitute criminal offences, —
units.label: Part 7 Art. 14.13

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to three thousand roubles; for officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles, or disqualification for six months to two years.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 14.13 · “shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens…”

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: 8. Failure to comply with an effective judicial act imposing subsidiary liability on persons controlling a debtor for the obligations of that debtor declared bankrupt, provided that the act does not constitute a criminal offence, except where that judicial act has been appealed to a court of cassation and the court of cassation has not issued a judicial act on it, or where the period for appealing the judicial act imposing subsidiary liability to a court of cassation has not expired, —
units.label: Part 8 Art. 14.13

units.locator: Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy
units.text: shall entail disqualification of officials for six months to three years.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 14.13 · “shall entail disqualification of officials for six months to…”
